observations: Photo 0 shows two stacked keyboards: a black keyboard with a small screen and button panel on top, and a larger grey/silver keyboard without a visible screen below it, both on a stand.
No brand name, model number, or serial plate is legible on either keyboard in the photo.
No adapter, power cable, or packaging is visible in the frame.
Image resolution is too low to confirm wear, chips, or key condition in detail.

claims.evidence: No model name, logo, or badge is readable on either keyboard in photo 0.
No video or audio provided showing keys or buttons responding.
No proof of purchase, import sticker, or UK plug shown.
Audio/functional claim cannot be judged from a still photo.

risks.risk: Two different keyboards appear in the same photo, so it's unclear which unit is actually for sale or whether both are included.
risks.proof: A photo or short video showing only the item for sale, clearly separated, with its model badge visible.
risks.if_unproven: priced as the lower-value, unidentified unit since the exact item for sale is ambiguous

risks.risk: Keys, buttons, or sound engine may be non-functional despite the seller's claim.
risks.proof: A video panning across the keyboard while playing a scale and demonstrating a few function buttons and the display.

risks.risk: Adapter may be missing, wrong voltage/plug type, or non-original.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the adapter with its label (voltage, plug type) next to the keyboard.
risks.if_unproven: priced as if no adapter included

risks.risk: Cosmetic damage (cracked casing, missing/sticking keys, scratched screen) not visible at this resolution.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the full keyboard from multiple angles, including the screen and key surfaces.
risks.if_unproven: priced assuming visible cosmetic wear, worst case within typical used range

risks.risk: Model identity cannot be confirmed, so true specification/value tier is unknown.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the brand/model plate or sticker on the back or near the control panel.
risks.if_unproven: priced as a generic unidentified portable keyboard, not as the claimed named model

proof_requests: Photo clearly showing only the keyboard being sold, with a legible brand/model plate or sticker.
Video of the keyboard powered on, playing several keys across the range, and operating a few buttons.
Photo of the power adapter including its label (voltage/plug type).
Close-up photos of the keyboard body, screen, and key surfaces from multiple angles.
response.reason: The photo shows two different keyboards without any legible brand or model marking, so it is unclear which item is actually for sale, and no worst-case identity can be fixed without a clearer photo isolating the item and showing its model plate.
